title: fix(runtime): the /automation definition doors record which user saved a flow
body:
Part of #27414. This PR delivers the `sys_metadata` half: the row's `created_by` / `updated_by` and its history's `recorded_by`. The `sys_audit_log` half is not in this PR. Its null `user_id` is produced in `packages/metadata-protocol`, outside this card's claimed file surface, and the same null appears on the `/meta` door (measured below). The report on the card says how to finish it.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 管理员通过 `POST /api/v1/automation`(新建)、`PUT /api/v1/automation/:name`(更新)、`POST /api/v1/automation/:name/clone`(克隆)保存 flow 时,`sys_metadata` 行的 `created_by` / `updated_by` 和历史行的 `recorded_by` 现在记的是这位管理员,不再是空。
- **为什么改:** 三个门共用 `registerAndSaveFlow`,它调 `saveMetaItem` 时没带 `actor`。`/meta` 门一直带着,所以同一个 flow 从 `/meta` 存能记人,从 `/automation` 存就记不到。ADR-0073 D3 要求归属必须具体。
- **风险与回滚:** 只多传一个用户 id,取自已鉴权的执行上下文,不读请求体;无用户的系统调用照旧不带 actor。回滚 = revert 本 PR。未解决:同一写入的 `sys_audit_log` 行 `user_id` 仍为空,`/meta` 门也一样,根因在 `packages/metadata-protocol`,不在本卡文件面内。
- **先看:** `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts` 的 `registerAndSaveFlow`(`saveMetaItem` 那一行);`packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-flow-save-actor.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/automation-flow-save-actor.test.ts`,预期 3/3 通过:新建、更新、克隆的行都写着调用者 id,无用户的对照写 null。
- **需要你做的:** 无,席位落地。

## What changes

- `registerAndSaveFlow` in `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation.ts` is the one persistence path for `POST /automation`, `PUT /automation/:name` and `POST /automation/:name/clone`. It now passes the caller's user id as `saveMetaItem`'s `actor`. The id is read through `activationCaller(context)`, the helper the toggle door uses since PR #26605: the signed-in user's id from the execution context and nothing else, never from the body. A context with no user passes no `actor`, so a system write stays unattributed as before.
- The three callers already passed `context` into the function, so no caller changed.
- `automation-authoring-doors-durable.test.ts`: two exact-argument pins on `saveMetaItem` now include `actor: 'u_admin'`, the id of the context those tests already send.

## Tests

<details><summary>Measured before the change, on the stock showcase (fresh file DB, signed in as admin@objectos.ai), at base ded67bfb</summary>

The three `/automation` doors and, as a control, `PUT /api/v1/meta/flow/:name`. Then each new `sys_metadata` row and the `sys_audit_log` rows on `sys_metadata`:

```text
row qa_clone_before  created_by None updated_by None
row qa_create_before created_by None updated_by None      (created by POST, then updated by PUT)
row qa_meta_before   created_by O9Nq...BM updated_by O9Nq...BM   (control: the /meta door)
audit create sys_metadata (meta row)   user_id None actor None
audit update sys_metadata (create row) user_id None actor None
audit create sys_metadata (create row) user_id None actor None
audit create sys_metadata (clone row)  user_id None actor None
```

Create and update show the same null actor as clone, so all three are in scope (same function, same fix). The audit rows are null on all four doors, including the `/meta` door that already passes `actor`.
</details>

<details><summary>Measured after the change, same rig, runtime rebuilt (head d325afae)</summary>

```text
row qa_clone_after  created_by LzwM...1y updated_by LzwM...1y
row qa_create_after created_by LzwM...1y updated_by LzwM...1y
row qa_meta_after   created_by LzwM...1y updated_by LzwM...1y   (control, unchanged)
audit create/update sys_metadata, all four rows: user_id None actor None   (not changed by this PR)
```
</details>

- New `packages/runtime/src/domains/automation-flow-save-actor.test.ts` (3 cases). It uses a real store, the same rig as `meta-save-actor.test.ts`: better-sqlite3 `:memory:`, the real `sys_metadata*` objects and a real `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation`. The door is driven through the real `HttpDispatcher`, and the rows are read back. Create records the creator, update by another user records that user as updater, clone records the cloning admin. The control is a caller with no user: its rows record null on all three doors.

<details><summary>Ablation (one mutation, through scripts/ablation-replace.mjs)</summary>

- The fix was committed first. Mutation: `saveMetaItem`'s argument lost the `actor` spread. Anchor 1 to 0, blob 14a061fa to 540e6524.
- Result: 4 failed, 10 passed. The failures were the 2 durable pins and the create/update and clone row pins. The no-user control stayed green.
- Restore: blob back to HEAD (14a061fa), `git diff HEAD` empty.
- The runtime suite imports `automation.ts` from `src` (relative import), so no rebuild was needed to observe the mutation.
</details>

- Package suites at head 85514752, under the verify lock: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck` exit 0, including its test-layer check. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test`: 472 files passed, 7671 tests passed, 19 skipped.
- After merging `origin/main` (head f1f7ce31; incoming commits touch `objectql`, so its closure was rebuilt): 6 related files re-run (the new pin, durable, tenant-authored-write, flow-clone, meta-save-actor, toggle-caller), 47/47 passed.

## Acceptance notes

- **Not delivered: the `sys_audit_log` half of #27414.** `SysMetadataRepository.put` in `packages/metadata-protocol/src/sys-metadata-repository.ts` writes the `sys_metadata` row under `{ ...ctx, isSystem: true }`, with no `session.userId` and no `provenance.attributedUserId`. The audit writer in `plugin-audit` takes `user_id` from exactly those two fields, so the audit row names nobody on every metadata save door. The `/meta` door is included, and the live control above shows it. The `actor` reaches `updated_by` / `created_by` / `recorded_by` but never the engine write's context. That file is outside this card's claimed surface, so it is left to the seat.
- The toggle doors record the user on their audit rows because their writes run with the caller's id on the context. That is the activation ledger, a different write path.

- NOT MEASURED, prerequisite not met (exit 3), left to CI: `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (shallow clone, its pinned control commit is unreachable; the scan itself exited 0) and `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (needs a full workspace build).
